entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 07-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned APP for the State.
2. In this case, the petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Chand P.S. Case No. 86 of 2023, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366(A) and 376 of the IPC.
3. As per prosecution case, at the pretext of earning money and performing marriage, co-accused Manish Kumar kidnapped the minor daughter of the informant and committed rape upon her.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.
He further submits in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, the victim made allegation of rape only against the co- Patna High Court CR.

MISC.
No.68757 of 2024(2) dt.07-10-2024 accused Manish Kumar.
No allegation of rape was levelled against the petitioner in her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
The petitioner is under custody since 07.08.2024.

sentences.text: Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, the petitioner, above-named be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge, POCSO Act-cum-A.D.J.-VI, Kaimur at Bhabua in connection with Chand P.S. Case No. 86 of 2023, subject to the condition that the petitioner shall cooperate in the disposal of trial and make himself available as and when required by the court.
